cues: Let's connect your Facebook and Instagram leads to Wedding Yantra.
It's easy.
Before you start, you need a Facebook Page for your business.
Not your personal profile.
You must be an admin of that Page, with full control.
And you need a lead form on Facebook.
Facebook calls it an Instant Form.
Now open Wedding Yantra.
Go to Leads, and tap Connect now.
Tap the orange button: Continue with Facebook.
Facebook opens. Log in, and tap Continue as your name.
Tick your business Page.
Keep every switch on, and tap Save.
You come back to Wedding Yantra.
Tick your Page, and tap Switch on.
When it says Receiving leads, you're connected.
Each new lead goes to the salesperson with the fewest open leads.
They get an alert on their phone.
Now let's test it.
Tap Send a test lead.
Test lead received.
It works!
That's it.
New leads from your ads now come into Wedding Yantra by themselves, with an alert.
Need help?
Open Leads, and tap See how.
Every step is there, with pictures.
